title: Density of large holes among power-free lattice points
summary: For fixed integers $d,r\ge1$ with $dr\ge2$, the $r$-free points of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ are those whose coordinate gcd is not divisible by the $r$th power of any prime. Fix $1\le q\le \infty$. A lattice point is $R$-deep if every lattice point in the closed $\ell_q$-ball of radius $R$ centred there is non-$r$-free. We mark each finite nearest-neighbour component of non-$r$-free points containing an $R$-deep point by its lexicographically least such point.
